🟣Fintokei Quartz Step 1
1,008,305 yen ↘️ 1,007,386 yen

🔴XM [principal 80,000 yen]
86,713 yen ➡️ 86,713 yen

💰Real accounts total
+78,372 yen ➡️ +78,372 yen

💰Prop total
-60,931 yen

💰FX 2026 total
+17,441 yen ➡️ +17,441 yen
――――――――――――――――
Gold shot up on the jobs report, so I piled in aiming to clear Step 1 in one go, and it fully retraced (全モ, i.e. 全戻し) 😱😱 Boring 😥

At XM I've had no position for the past several days 😓 My basic strategy is to hold "treasure positions" for the long term, so I can't find an attractive currency pair right now 💦
――――――――――――――――
・Prop accounts alive/purchased: 1/16
・Total expenses: -559,750 yen
・Total withdrawals: +498,819 yen
・Net profit/loss: -60,931 yen

・FX lifetime total: about -5,000,000 yen
About 105,000,000 yen more to the goal of 100,000,000 yen 😙

This month I've completely said goodbye to overseas FX with XM and HFM.

The remaining ThreeTrader (スリトレ) has the "10,000 yen challenge" left half-finished, so I'll think about what to do with it from here 🧐

Thanks for all this time.
Farewell, high-leverage warriors 🫡

In my overseas FX history, the one I've used most heavily is... definitely XM.
I'm unhappy with the spreads, but above all it's easy to use. It has a wide range of instruments...
And the fact that there are no problems with withdrawals is also highly rated by me personally!

The next ones I used were... exness  bigboss Titan ThreeTrader (スリトレ) Vantage  axi   　and I also used Gem (probably GEMFOREX)...

There are so many that I can't remember them all, but it's roughly like this☺️
